mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_FILE_S ( ATFL_KY_VAL, ATFL_GRUP_NM, UNQ_NO, ATFL_ID, ATFL_PTH_NM, ATFL_TITL_NM, ATFL_ORSRC_NM, ATFL_PHCL_NM, ATFL_FEXT_NM, ATFL_SZ, RG_DT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(ATFL_KY_VAL), 0) +1 FROM GE_MP_FILE_S), #{ATFL_GRUP_NM}, #{UNQ_NO}, #{ATFL_ID}, #{ATFL_PTH_NM}, #{ATFL_TITL_NM}, #{ATFL_ORSRC_NM}, #{ATFL_PHCL_NM}, #{ATFL_FEXT_NM}, #{ATFL_SZ}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_FILE_S SET DLT_YN = 'Y' WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM = #{ATFL_GRUP_NM} AND UNQ_NO IN (${CHK_ITEMS})
mapper.select: SELECT ATFL_KY_VAL, ATFL_GRUP_NM, UNQ_NO, ATFL_ID, ATFL_PTH_NM, ATFL_TITL_NM, ATFL_ORSRC_NM, ATFL_PHCL_NM, ATFL_FEXT_NM, ATFL_SZ FROM GE_MP_FILE_S A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.ATFL_GRUP_NM = #{ATFL_GRUP_NM} AND A.UNQ_NO = #{UNQ_NO} AND A.ATFL_ID = #{ATFL_ID}
